Experience

Directed the creation of high-impact motion graphics, marketing
campaigns, and visual content for global brands including PepsiCo,
Target, Dell, Nestlé, Cintas, and BAE.
Built end-to-end creative workflows—from concept development
and storyboarding to animation, AI-assisted asset generation
(Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Runway), editing, and final delivery.
Produced multi-format campaign assets and creative variations for
social platforms, supporting A/B testing while collaborating with
cross-functional teams to deliver projects on schedule.

Interactive Media and Visual Designer
Alight Solutions

2025 – Present

Designed and delivered motion graphics, 2D/3D animations, VFX,
and composited videos for branded campaigns, product
explainers, and social-first content in collaboration with cross-
functional teams.

Assistant Video Producer

Battery Smart

2023 - 2025

Produced motion graphics, VFX-enhanced videos, compositing,
and post-production for social media campaigns, ensuring
engaging visual storytelling.
Partnered with clients and internal stakeholders to develop
branding, campaign creatives, and social-first visual content.

Video Editor

Social Sthaan

 2022- 2023

Created motion graphics, visual effects, compositing, and
creative video content from concept to final delivery while
maintaining brand consistency.

Video Editor
Social Mongers 

 2021- 2022

About Me
Video Producer and Motion Designer with 6+ years of
experience across video production, motion graphics,
branded content and AI-assisted creative workflows.
Experienced in taking projects from concept and visual
development through editing, animation, post-
production and final delivery. Hands-on with Adobe
Creative Cloud and generative AI tools including Firefly,
Midjourney and Runway, with experience collaborating
with cross-functional teams, stakeholders and clients in
fast-paced production environments.
